itineraries.title: Cinque Terre 3-4 day itinerary
itineraries.summary: Tanya Khanijow's 3-4 day Cinque Terre plan: explore one or two villages per day (Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza, Monterosso) combining sightseeing, cafe hopping, beach time and short hikes; evenings for sunset views and seaside dining. September named best month; mid-range cost from India estimated at INR 1-1.2 lakh per person (Schengen visa ~INR 9,000; return flights to Rome INR 35,000-40,000; train INR 2,750-3,000; accommodation 3-4 days INR 35,000-40,000). Published via Whosthat360 ~2026-09-15. Items carry no day numbers because the source gives no day-by-day mapping.

itineraries.title: Perfect 3-Day Goa Itinerary for Slow Travel
itineraries.summary: Shivya Nath's own-blog 3-day slow-travel Goa plan, updated ~2026-08-06. North Goa: Day 1 — explore the Goan neighbourhood (walks, bakery, market), cycle/e-bike Chorao island with Cycling Zens or B:Live, thrift at Good Karma (Vagator), shop organic fair-trade at No Nasties (Assagao). Day 2 — hike to a secret waterfall/swimming hole with Beatroute Explorers or The Local Beat. Day 3 — surfing lesson with Salty Soul (Mandrem), lazy beach day at Morjim/Ashwem/Keri. Stay picks: Cancio's House (Aldona), Siolim House, Jardin d'Ulysse, Botanique, Mojigao, The Secret Garden; South Goa: Casa Jaali, Tanshikar Spice Farm, Mangaal Farmstay, Cabo Serai, Alila Diwa. Eat: Kokni Kanteen, Mum's Kitchen (Panjim), Bloom & Brew, The Rice Mill, Bean Me Up, Moka.

items.details: Fly into Pristina, described as a reasonably priced gateway into North Macedonia and Montenegro.
items.name: Flight into Pristina (airline not specified by creator)

items.details: Rental car pickup; cross-border green card purchased at pickup for about $25. Kosovo rentals $30-40/day, Montenegro ~$70/day in high season; one-way drop-off ~$500 extra; full coverage ~$11/day extra.
items.name: Discover Cars

items.details: Lunch stop in Skopje at an unnamed restaurant overlooking the river, plus a walk through the Old Bazaar and over the Stone Bridge.

items.details: Lakefront hotel with included beach chairs and paddleboards, rooftop spa, breakfast, parking and pool. She recommends one night on the lake and one night near the Old Town.

items.name: Paddle boarding on Lake Ohrid

items.details: Tandem paraglide over the lake and old town; flight itself only ~8 minutes after a long drive up into the mountains.

itineraries.summary: Alyssa Ramos's 9-day luxury-adventure Balkans roadtrip: fly into Pristina, drive to Lake Ohrid in North Macedonia for paddle boarding and paragliding, return through Prizren in Kosovo with an optional Peja adventure day, then take the night bus to Montenegro for Budva's coast, a Kotor day trip with the cable car, and the wine country near Podgorica. An Albania detour (Tirana, Ksamil) is offered as an optional 2-3 day add-on.
itineraries.title: Ultimate Balkans Roadtrip Travel Guide for Luxury Adventurers

itineraries.summary: Alyssa Ramos's 3-day Cuba itinerary: Day 1 exploring Trinidad's colonial center (Plaza Mayor, Museo Romantico, bell tower, evening cooking or salsa class), Day 2 hiking to waterfalls and natural pools in Parque Guanayara, Day 3 kayaking the Bay of Cienfuegos to Castillo de Jagua with a lobster lunch, then the city square and malecon. Casa particular stays throughout; written with U.S.-citizen travel notes.
